# Trinity Pump & Supply

> Your Trusted Partner for Downhole Rod Pumps and Oilfield Supplies. Delivering high-quality USA-manufactured pump parts and services across Texas and New Mexico since 2020. Located at 2501 FM 866, Odessa, TX 79763. Phone: 830-279-3996. Email: trinitypumpsupply@gmail.com.

Trinity Pump & Supply is a premier oilfield supply and downhole rod pump service provider based in Odessa, Texas. We deliver unmatched quality, rapid turnaround, and customized artificial lift solutions to exploration and production operators across the Permian Basin, Texas, and New Mexico.

## Core Navigation & Pages

- [Home](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/): Company overview, core products, and customer testimonials
- [Services](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Comprehensive downhole rod pump repair, assembly, tracking, and field delivery
- [HD Rod Rotator](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/hd-rod-rotator/): Burleson heavy-duty rod rotator equipment and parts
- [About Us](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/about-us/): Leadership, shop capabilities, and company mission
- [Reviews](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/#reviews): Testimonials from operators including Sabinal Energy and ConocoPhillips
- [Contact Us](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/contact-us/): Request quotes, service dispatch, and shop location

## Specialized Oilfield Services & Products

- [Downhole Rod Pumps](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Custom rod pump manufacturing, API barrel sizing, full teardown inspection, pump tracking, and field delivery
- [Burleson HD Rod Rotator](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/hd-rod-rotator/): Heavy-duty rod rotator engineered for extreme Permian Basin well conditions to prevent tubing wear
- [Downhole Supplies](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Balls and seats, plungers, cage valves, sucker rods, pony rods, and hold-down assemblies
- [General Oilfield Supplies](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Comprehensive wellsite components, stuffing boxes, packing, polished rods, and chemical fittings
- [Poly Pipe & Fittings](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): High-density polyethylene piping, fusion fittings, and transfer line equipment
- [Battery & Wellhead Supplies](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Production manifold components, valves, gauges, and tank battery equipment
